en.title: CCTV Shows Moment When IIT Student Was Stopped During Exam, Pulled Aside
en.summary: An IIT Bombay student died by suicide in his hostel room. The incident involved the student being stopped and pulled aside during an exam, as shown in CCTV footage.

en.title: Noida District Magistrate Gets Relief, Supreme Court Pauses Rs 5-Lakh Compensation
en.summary: The Supreme Court has paused a Rs 5-lakh compensation order against a Noida District Magistrate and also stayed the operation of a judgment that had quashed the official's detention.

stories.title: Ladakh bodies hold protests ahead of Sep. 24 violence anniversary; Ladakh L-G withdraws cases against 20 locals

en.title: Ladakh bodies hold protests ahead of Sep. 24 violence anniversary; Ladakh L-G withdraws cases against 20 locals
en.summary: Activist Sonam Wangchuk led a symbolic march in Leh to commemorate the first anniversary of September 24, 2025 violence that occurred during protests demanding statehood and constitutional protections for Ladakh. The Ladakh Lieutenant Governor has withdrawn cases against 20 local residents.

stories.title: Supreme Court stays High Court order to recover ₹5 lakh from Noida DM in NSA detention case

en.title: Supreme Court stays High Court order to recover ₹5 lakh from Noida DM in NSA detention case
en.summary: India's Supreme Court has halted a High Court order requiring a Noida District Magistrate to pay 500,000 rupees in connection with a National Security Act detention case. The defense argued that administrative decisions involve multiple review levels and should not single out individuals for penalties.

en.title: In meeting with Rubio, Jaishankar raises India's concerns about sanctions Act
en.summary: India's External Affairs Minister raised concerns about a sanctions act during discussions with the U.S. Secretary of State. Both officials are preparing for planned high-level meetings between U.S. President Donald Trump and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi later this year.

stories.title: One Indian killed after ship attacked off Oman coast; MEA condemns incident

en.title: One Indian killed after ship attacked off Oman coast; MEA condemns incident
en.summary: The MV Cape Dao was attacked off Oman while traveling to India, killing one Indian crew member and resulting in 19 others being rescued. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the attack and is coordinating the repatriation of the remaining crew.

en.summary: Pakistan's cricket team aims to pressure India at the Asian Games, referencing their recent Asia Cup strategy. Pakistan has lost multiple matches to India in recent competitions.

stories.title: US stocks: US market ends down as oil prices, Treasury yields rise

en.title: US stocks: US market ends down as oil prices, Treasury yields rise
en.summary: US stock markets declined as Alphabet and Amazon underperformed while Treasury yields and oil prices increased following remarks by Iran's President at the UN. Despite the downturn, strong US business activity has sparked expectations of potential Federal Reserve interest rate increases.

en.title: Melania Trump rings New York Stock Exchange opening bell to launch new women's initiative Imperia
en.summary: Melania Trump launched her women's leadership and economic empowerment initiative, Imperia, at the New York Stock Exchange opening ceremony. She highlighted women's contributions to the global economy and raised awareness of war-separated children reunification issues.

stories.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr signals more rate hikes needed to tame inflation

en.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr signals more rate hikes needed to tame inflation
en.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr indicated that additional interest rate increases may be needed to combat inflation, which remains above the Fed's 2% target despite strong economic growth. The Fed's policy rate currently stands at 3.75%-4.00%.

stories.title: 10-year US Treasury yields surges over 5.05% to 19-year high

en.title: 10-year US Treasury yields surges over 5.05% to 19-year high
en.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield reached 5.058%, its highest level since July 2007, driven by fresh economic data that raised concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate increases. The rising yields put significant downward pressure on equity markets, especially technology and growth-oriented stocks.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $86,000 as spot Bitcoin ETF inflows hit 11-month high of $999 million

en.title: Bitcoin holds near $86,000 as spot Bitcoin ETF inflows hit 11-month high of $999 million
en.summary: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 after US spot Bitcoin ETFs received nearly $999 million in inflows in a single day, their strongest performance in 11 months. Institutional demand and short liquidations supported the cryptocurrency's price stability.
